heroHeadline: France Activates Its First Offshore Wind Farm (500 MW) and First Floating Wind Farm Simultaneously — EV Tipping Point Confirmed in Europe and China
heroSubtitle: 3,798 days since the Paris Agreement — ENGIE's 500 MW EMYN bottom-fixed offshore wind farm came fully online off the Vendée coast on May 6, alongside France's first floating offshore wind power (EFGL, 30 MW, Gulf of Lion). A Nature Communications study confirms EVs have crossed the self-sustaining market tipping point in Europe and China, with price parity projected by 2025–2028. EU ETS carbon permits reached €75.97/tonne (+6.9% YoY) as CBAM enters its first full operational year. The EU's post-2030 climate consultation closed May 4, shaping implementation of the world's most ambitious legally binding target: –90% emissions by 2040.
footerNote: Data sourced from IEA, IRENA, IPCC, UNEP, BloombergNEF, and major international outlets. All figures reflect verified, publicly available data through May 2026.
